body:
We use Title Case for UndoRedo action names:

```suggestion
	undo_redo->create_action(TTR("Set Preview Sun Altitude"), UndoRedo::MergeMode::MERGE_ENDS);
```

This should also be changed for action names further below.

For reference, this is similar to what the project settings and editor settings do to support undo/redo within their respective popups:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/70eb62faf24223f1dcf90589f4b39d1be7609ca0/editor/editor_settings_dialog.cpp#L274-L298
